context_sources.name: UNHCR displacement report, cited through BBC

limitations: The symbol table has its meanings detached from the symbols.
The distance average prints with the divisor split from the sum.
The safety index prints with its terms scattered across the line.
The arrival sum prints with its indices on separate lines.
The population split in the summary has five numbers for six starts.
News addresses in the references are broken by spaces.

tasks: Define metrics for the factors that move refugees
Build the flow among origins and the six routes
Revise the flow when the first version fails
Simulate the movement quarter by quarter
Test the model at a larger scale
Set a policy for capacity and stability

section_map.summary: A failed random model, then gravity at 0.98, then three ratios at correlation one.
One in 122 displaced, 3695 dead in 2015, 32 percent granted.
Safety, acceptance, transport, repatriation, entry points.
Nine assumptions, each with a reason.
Eleven nodes, three layers, equal weights rejected.
Seven to Canada, fifty-one to America, a stated failure.
A cobweb: big capacity steadies the flow.
One plea for abundance, and an unfinished close.

contributions.summary: A failed equal-weight model kept on the page and then beaten by a gravity revision.
A node that closes once it stays above its limit.
A scalability test reported as a failure and blamed on the Himalayas.

dependency_graph.handoff: The layers decide which pairs receive a weight
The gravity weights split the quarterly departures
The same weights are reapplied on the larger map
The saturation seen at large scale motivates the stability rule

assumptions.summary: Refugees move in groups that follow a leader.
Movement is irreversible and nobody settles halfway.
The parameters are constant, or the problem is a dead end.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Three pairs of neighboring countries merged into single nodes.
Deaths by route taken from the fatal-journeys report.

models.summary: Three layers by distance, and an equal-weight run that fails.
A gravity weight built from safety, convenience and repatriation.
A quarterly cellular automaton with closure.
The same weights on Canada, America and China.
A cobweb relating capacity to stability.

verification.summary: Three lines overlaid: real data, revision, and the failed first model.
Three simulated shares against three observed shares.
A 5 percent capacity change moves the result 2 percent.

results_trace.summary: Safety first sends people onto the land routes.
Destination shares matched at a reported correlation of one.

writing_logic.summary: The first model is declared a failure with its statistics, then replaced.
Each priority weighting is translated back into behavior.
A wrong prediction is kept and explained by geography.

language_observations.summary: The summary reports the failure before the repair.
Every assumption carries its own excuse.
The cobweb figure supplies the policy directly.
The letter breaks off mid-sentence and signs off twice.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1: asylum applicants over five years.
Figure 2: the top thirteen origin countries.
Figure 3: the six routes and the nodes.
Figure 5: distances from nodes to the six starts.
Figure 9: mortality at sea by route.
Figure 10: the revised network with weights.
Figures 11 to 14: propagation by layer and the three-line comparison.
Figures 15 and 16: route ratios under two priorities.
Figures 17 to 19: the quarterly simulation and the two shocks.
Figure 20: the larger map, the stated failure.
Figures 21 and 22: the cobweb at two capacities.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The failed model is shown rather than omitted.
A correlation of exactly one is claimed on three points.
Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is promised and never used.

weaknesses.summary: The model sends almost nobody to Canada or America.
Distances are straight lines and ignore barriers.
Stowaways are excluded for lack of official data.

independent_extensions.summary: Replace straight-line distance with a distance that counts mountains and sea.
Report an error measure other than correlation on three points.
Write the cobweb as an equation with measured capacities.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Let the figure dictate the recommendation.
Name the point at which the model stops holding, and keep the failure.

unresolved_questions.question: Why do five ratios describe six start points?
How can the correlation be exactly one when 0.00362 is compared with 0.013?
Where is the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation the plan promises?
